videos.title: 7조원대 KDDX 한화 우선협상자 선정 [뉴스퍼레이드]
videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants a summary of a YouTube video transcript in Korean, around 500 characters, with 3-5 sentences, and absolutely no English.

2. The two companies competed for over 10 years
3. KDDX is a project to build six 6,000-ton class next-generation destroyers using domestic technology, total budget about 7.8 trillion won
4. HD Hyundai Heavy Industries received a 1.2 point penalty because employees were convicted of leaking military secrets related to KDDX
5. The final score difference between the two companies was only 0.5-0.6 points, so the penalty essentially decided the outcome
6. President Lee Jae-myung (note: this seems to be an error in the transcript or old news, as current president is Yoon Suk-yeol, but I should stick to what the transcript says) mentioned at a town hall meeting in December about checking companies that leaked military secrets
